summary: CI builds the Windows native bridge on every pull request and says when the committed libraries have gone stale

coordination.notes: game/bin/windows/*.dll are committed artefacts that nothing rebuilds when the bridge's exported verbs change. The scenario-runtime-loading lane deleted create_island and install_preview_factions and recorded the resulting staleness as failed, because no contributor without Windows can produce a replacement. This job closes that: windows-latest builds both configurations, asserts the two paths the .gdextension declares, reports whether the committed pair still matches the commit, and uploads windows-bridge-<sha>. It deliberately does not commit the binary; a binary enters the repository through a person who has looked at it. Touches no file either running scenario lane owns.
